title: While the World Slept
overview: When he realizes the world isn't as it used to be, Charlie Lyons must band together with an unlikely group of heroes to reverse the fate of the world. Not feeling as if he has a chance to face the challenge at hand, he unwillingly goes along with this group to defeat whatever it is that is attempting to destroy them. In the end, will Charlie face up to his fears and fight or will he hide and wait for the problem to sort itself out.
